text.desc:
Radius of the area in which the invisible cursor in the center of the wheel moves. 
The smaller the value, the more responsive the wheel is.
text.name: Cursor Radius Per Entry

text.desc:
If you hold onto the toggle key longer than this time(seconds), 
wheel automatically closes once you release the key.
text.name: Toggle Hold Threshold (seconds)

text.desc: When ON, Wheeler disables gameplay controls while edit mode is active in Inventory/Magic/Favorites. Turn OFF to keep v1.3-like behavior and avoid ControlMap blocking.
text.name: Block Game Input In Edit Mode

text.desc: When ON, Inventory/Magic/Favorites menus are hidden while Wheeler edit mode is active. Turn OFF to keep those menus visible behind Wheeler.
text.name: Hide Game UI In Edit Mode

text.desc: Let the wheel's toggle button keep its normal game function: the same press that opens or closes the wheel is also handed to the game, so a D-pad direction or a key bound in the game's controls still does what it always did. A toggle that uses a modifier is not affected. On by default. A D-pad direction with 'D-Pad Toggle: Hold To Open' on is not shared: it is decided by duration instead.
text.name: Toggle Key Keeps Its Game Function

text.desc: When the gamepad toggle is a D-pad direction with no modifier, HOLD it to open the wheel and TAP it to use the D-pad normally - the tap goes to the game or to the open menu as if Wheeler were not there. The hold length is Toggle Hold Threshold. Other buttons keep press-to-toggle. On by default.
text.name: D-Pad Toggle: Hold To Open, Tap For The Game

text.desc: Optional shortcut that opens the Apocrypha Menu Framework on Wheeler's page (framework 1.7.7 or newer). The framework's own key (F1 by default) opens these settings, so this ships unbound (0). DirectInput scan code; a key the framework reserves is refused.
text.name: Settings Page Key

text.desc: Optional controller shortcut that opens the Apocrypha Menu Framework on Wheeler's page. Ships unbound: every controller button already has a vanilla meaning, and the framework's menu is reachable with a controller on its own. 0 = unbound.
text.name: Settings Page Button (Gamepad)
